TENET5 · Public records · 30 cities · 52 findings · Updated July 2026
An investigation of auditor reports, commissions of inquiry, and council records — not opinion polls.

Across the country, the same story keeps writing itself in auditor reports and commission findings: transit projects that blow past budgets and schedules, contracts awarded without a real competition, developers who fund campaigns and shape the skyline, police budgets that grow while oversight shrinks — and in Québec, a construction–political system a royal commission mapped years ago and that…

This is not a database. It is an investigation of what governments have already admitted on paper — 52 findings in 30 municipalities , from Montréal’s Charbonneau file to Iqaluit’s fuel-spill cover-up.
